Markets.title: US stocks: US market sinks as bond yields rise, Walmart results disappoint
Markets.summary: US stocks fell as bond yields rose and Walmart reported disappointing results. The consumer discretionary sector and fuel-sensitive cruise lines led the market declines.

Markets.title: Shein targets September 1 for Hong Kong IPO: Report
Markets.summary: Fast-fashion giant Shein has delayed its Hong Kong initial public offering to September 1 due to slowing growth and rising costs. The company is now targeting a reduced valuation of $26 billion to $27 billion.

Markets.title: US Treasury's Bessent says upsized bond buybacks could increase further
Markets.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the government may further increase its upsized bond buybacks to improve market liquidity and economic confidence. At the same time, the Treasury is pursuing a fiscal consolidation plan to achieve hundreds of billions of dollars in savings.

Markets.title: St. Louis Fed's Musalem says on CNBC he won't prejudge rate call view for September FOMC
Markets.summary: St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem stated that keeping interest rates higher remains appropriate because inflation is still above the central bank's two percent target. He noted that he will not prejudge the September rate decision and emphasized the need for careful evaluation ahead of the FOMC meeting.

Markets.title: Upstox begins talks with investment banks for $350-400 million IPO; crosses 2 crore customers
Markets.summary: Investment platform Upstox is in talks with investment banks to raise $350 to $400 million through an upcoming initial public offering. The proposed IPO will consist of both new shares and an offer-for-sale as the company surpasses 2 crore customers.

Markets.title: Augmont Enterprises mops up Rs 246 crore in anchor round ahead of IPO; Nomura, HDFC MF among investors
Markets.summary: Augmont Enterprises raised Rs 246.3 crore from anchor investors, including Nomura and HDFC Mutual Fund, ahead of its IPO opening on August 21. The company will use the fresh issue proceeds for working capital and inventory, with shares scheduled to list on the NSE and BSE on August 31.

Geo-Political.title: US says sanctions will 'squash' Iran's economy and 'collapse' its regime
Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that impending US sanctions will destroy Iran's economy and cause its regime to collapse. He also warned international allies that they must choose whether to support the US sanctions or oppose them.

Geo-Political.title: UK, France, Germany, Italy and Canada condemn Israel's West Bank settlement project
Geo-Political.summary: The UK, France, Germany, Italy, and Canada have jointly condemned Israel's plans to expand settlements in the occupied West Bank. This international pressure targets a strategically vital area of the territory.

Geo-Political.title: Russia 'purposefully' hit critical infrastructure in latest strikes, Kyiv mayor says
Geo-Political.summary: Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko stated that Russia purposely targeted critical infrastructure during a massive overnight attack that killed at least 17 people. The strikes disrupted the hot water supply across Ukraine's capital.

Geo-Political.title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
Geo-Political.summary: The founder of Evergrande, Hui Ka Yan, has been sentenced to life in prison following the collapse of his Chinese property company. This ruling represents a significant development in the aftermath of the financial crisis that severely impacted China's real estate sector.

Geo-Political.title: Como mayor hit by electric bike and issues blanket ban in Italian city
Geo-Political.summary: Como Mayor Alessandro Rapinese banned electric bikes in the Italian city after being struck by one himself. He stated that the blanket prohibition was implemented to ensure public safety.

Geo-Political.title: Assad officer extradited to Syria on war crimes charges for first time
Geo-Political.summary: Lebanon extradited former Syrian General Adel Issa to Syria to face war crimes charges. This marks the first time an Assad regime officer has been handed over on such charges as Syria steps up its pursuit of former officials.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: To lower record domestic sugar prices, the Indian government has eliminated import duties on the commodity. This decision follows earlier actions to restrict sugar exports and tighten limits on stock holdings.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth eases to 5.4% in July from 6% in June; iron ore, cement drive expansion
Data & Insights.summary: India's core infrastructure sectors grew by 5.4% in July, slowing down from June's revised 6% growth rate. This expansion was primarily driven by the iron ore, cement, and electricity sectors.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. This is because the currency's impact depends on whether the central bank allows the inflows to enter the market or absorbs them as reserves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank requires clearer evidence of persistent inflation before taking action. The Monetary Policy Committee indicated it may implement future policy tightening if high prices continue.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — The economics of India's toll highways landscape
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highway Management Company shows that high-traffic routes and the FASTag annual pass are driving highway revenues. The data also highlights changing trends in private sector involvement across India's toll road network.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research has increased India's GDP growth estimate for fiscal year 2027 to 6.8%. However, ongoing downside risks include the West Asia war, high inflation, a weakening currency, and lower-than-expected capital expenditure.

India.title: China To Be India's Main Competitor Across Multiple Fields: Ex-Army Chief
India.summary: Former Army Chief General Manoj Naravane stated that China will be India's primary competitor across political, economic, trade, and military sectors. This multidimensional competition marks a significant strategic challenge for India.

India.title: To Wean Young Punjab From Drugs, Bhagwant Mann's New Recipe: Sports
India.summary: The Punjab government has announced the fourth edition of the "Khedan Wattan Punjab Diyan" sports initiative. The program aims to use sports as a key tool to steer the state's youth away from drug use.

India.title: Video: Bengaluru Man Almost Run Over By Tanker After Bike Hits Pothole
India.summary: A Bengaluru motorcyclist was almost run over by a water tanker after hitting a pothole on the road. The rider lost control of his bike, which was subsequently crushed under the wheels of the approaching vehicle.

India.title: Speeding Aston Martin Rams, Kills Woman In Hyderabad, MP's Son Charged
India.summary: A speeding Aston Martin driven by Sanjush, son of Lingamaneni Ramesh, struck and killed a 26-year-old mall saleswoman named Bharathi in Hyderabad. The driver has been charged in connection with the fatal accident.

India.title: Fungus In Vegetables, Expired Products Found At 36 Train Stations In Karnataka
India.summary: Inspections at 36 train stations in Karnataka revealed fungal growth on onions and vegetables. Officials also discovered expired products and chutney stored in unsafe plastic buckets.

India.title: 'Government Deceived Us': Jharkhand Students As Court Stays Exam Cancellation
India.summary: Jharkhand students who protested for 26 days suspended their agitation after the government canceled 22 recruitment exams. A court has now stayed that cancellation, prompting students to accuse the government of deception.

General.title: Harry and Meghan's return to UK reignites questions over security
General.summary: Harry and Meghan's surprise return to the UK has triggered new debates about their security arrangements. Authorities must now decide what level of publicly funded protection the couple will receive.

General.title: Watch: What does Harry's return mean for his fractured relationship with William?
General.summary: Prince Harry and Prince William have experienced a fractured relationship for several years. Harry's recent return raises questions about the future of this strained dynamic between the brothers.

General.title: Five key takeaways from GCSE results day 2026
General.summary: On GCSE results day 2026, student resits increased and the performance gap between boys and girls narrowed. At the same time, the regional educational divide across England widened.

General.title: US says sanctions will 'squash' Iran's economy and 'collapse' its regime
General.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that new US sanctions will crush Iran's economy and cause its regime to collapse. He added that US allies must decide whether they stand with or against the United States on this issue.

General.title: Academic who accused Jason Arday of plagiarism suspended by university
General.summary: Academic Nathan Cofnas has been suspended by his university while under investigation for allegedly discriminating against the late Cambridge professor Jason Arday. The investigation follows Cofnas's public accusations that Arday committed plagiarism.

General.title: John Swinney defends £45,000 business-class flights to World Cup
General.summary: John Swinney defended the Scottish government's spending of £45,000 on business-class flights to the World Cup. These trips were part of nearly £100,000 spent on official visits to the United States in June.
